From: • James C. Bowling

C

C

Alex Holtzman and I represented Philip Morris at the Tobacco Institute Executive Committee meeting on March 13.
I have very extensive notes on the meeting and am prepared to discuss them.

Chairman Curt Judge has called another meeting of the Executive Committee for Wednesday, March 26 at 2:30 p.m. in the Sir Francis Room of the Drake Hotel, Park Avenue at 56th Street in New York.

The subject of the meeting is Tobacco Institute Consumer Advertising. This evolves from growing concern about legislative issues (particularly restrictive measures related to the smoker/non-smoker controversy.) Judge invited the company members to submit campaign recommendations by their respective advertising agencies--in addition to considering the prepared Tobacco Institute campaign.

1005054500

Would like to discuss this with you at your convenience.

[SIGNATURE] James C. Bowling
